title: "D: panzoom filter, no document lightbox key (selective mode)"
execute:
  echo: fenced
format:
  html:
    code-tools: true
filters:
  - panzoom
---

::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page **tests the panzoom extension**. The panzoom filter is on, and the
images marked with `.panzoom` or `#| classes: panzoom` should open the pan/zoom
viewer. The document has no `lightbox:` key, so Quarto's lightbox only applies
where a case asks for it (the `#| lightbox:` cell options in cases 6 and 7).
Case 6's first chunk has both on purpose: panzoom should win, and its
`#| lightbox:` options are dropped, so it doesn't join GLightbox's gallery.
Case 9's link should still work (images inside links are left alone).

Compare each case with the same numbered case in [`a-lightbox`](a-lightbox.html), which
renders the same cases with Quarto's lightbox alone.
:::

Two markdown subfigures (see @fig-md-a).
:::

## 5. R subfigures (fig-subcap, layout-ncol) {#c5}

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-sub
#| fig-cap: "Two R subfigures."
#| fig-subcap: ["Pressure", "Cars"]
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| classes: panzoom
plot(pressure)
plot(cars)
```

## 6. R chunks with lightbox cell options (group + description) {#c6}

This one also has `classes: panzoom` (conflict test).

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Simple demo R plot
#| classes: panzoom
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: This is 1 to 10 plot
plot(1:10, rnorm(10))
```

This one has only the lightbox options.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Plot about cars data
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: We see our cars data above
plot(cars)
```

## 7. Multi-plot cell, list-valued options {#c7}

```{r}
#| classes: panzoom
#| fig-cap:
#|   - Caption for first plot
#|   - Caption for second plot
#| lightbox:
#|   group: cars
#|   description:
#|     - Description for first graph
#|     - Description for second graph
plot(mtcars)
plot(cars)
```

## 8. lightbox: false on a chunk {#c8}

```{r}
#| fig-cap: mtcars, lightbox false
#| lightbox: false
plot(mtcars)
```
